title: Puck world silo (puck.silo.def.v1)
description: The silo document (puck.silo.def.v1) — durable configuration for one Puck.World.Silo process: which worlds it may activate, its declared door budget, where its checkpoints/journals/definitions live, its own state directory, and its clustering membership. Loaded once at silo start (--silo <path>); nothing in it is simulation state. See WorldSiloDefinitionValidator for the checks a document must pass before the silo composes against it.

worlds.description: Every world this silo may activate, keyed by World.

items.description: One world this silo activates. Its own host.authority (read from its definition after load) is the subject its federation key signs as — never this silo's own identity.

world.description: The world id under that owner's container — the grain key's own extension.

keyFile.description: The path to the PKCS#8 private-key file this row signs its outbound federation claims and its own door's admission challenges with.

pinned.description: Whether this row activates at silo start and never idle-deactivates.

budget.description: The maximum number of Pinned rows this silo may activate at start.

directoryPath.description: The root directory — required when Kind is Directory, otherwise absent.

accountUrl.description: The Azure Blob account endpoint (e.g. https://bytrcstp001.blob.core.windows.net) — required when Kind is Azure, otherwise absent.

stateDir.description: The root every activated row's container-ephemeral owned-world store resolves its own directory under — the --state-dir counterpart.

tableName.description: The Storage Table name — required when Kind is Table, otherwise absent (a local run names no table).

schema.description: Gets the document schema tag — SchemaVersion for a well-formed document.
